svg.title: NEON SPORE · VISUAL SYSTEM
svg.text: generated by `bun run style-guide` from PALETTE, STROKE and silhouettes.ts — docs/style-guide.md

g.text: a bulb at its shipped 26 px, magnified x3.6. Last cell: the same creature shot in the wrong colour.
SIZE · a creature ships at 20-26 px
the same bulb down the ladder. At 11 px nothing of a figure survives, which is why liveliness comes from motion and not from detail.
one colour, because a kind has none of its own — it wears the ammunition that kills it. The small row is what the pair sees.
DEPTH · a silhouette is posed, a surface is placed
eight marks, half a turn. An affine slides them at one rate and hides none; longitude crowds them at the limb and takes them behind.
COLOUR · a hue ships as a triad
body S 81-100 L 51-68 · rim L 77-93 · deep L 10-26, and the deep never reaches the background
the two accents. 345° and 185°. Everything else must be unmistakable for either.
violet hull, cyan shield — the shield shares the cyan accent, because the shield is the thing that answers it.
`good` is the round answered in full. The other three were granted by name, and each is held apart by hue and by where it appears.
a hue spent on a single body or hazard, placed in a gap and touching neither neighbour.
not a colour but a sweep: THE BALLOON's skin runs 245°–290°–320° and back, so no hue on it ever holds still long enough to be named.
colder and bluer than the dark, at 224°. The rock is immune because it does not live, and it throws no light.
one desaturated violet, 247°–252°, so the whole picture sits inside the hull's hue. A neutral says `nothing to report`.
HUE PLACEMENT · a new colour goes in a gap
the twelve body hues at their measured angles. A hue touching a neighbour is one the pair says the wrong word for.
